MRVL.headline: AI Stocks Surge on Tuesday: AEHR, Fabrinet, and Lattice Semiconductor All Jump More than 10%

The backdrop is rough: stocks in the technology, media and telecom momentum factor are down 62% from their 52-week high, a sharper correction than the dot-com bust, as hedge funds cut AI positions and money rotates into defensive areas like consumer staples. Shares of Aehr Test Systems (NASDAQ: AEHR) are up 22%. The company makes burn-in test equipment, and sales are expected to triple this year. Fabrinet (NYSE: FN) is up 13%, with CEO Seamus Grade saying optics demand looks very sustainable. That matters after Marvell Technology (NASDAQ: MRVL) announced a $115 billion buyout of Lumentum (NASDAQ: LITE), a deal that sent both stocks lower. Lattice Semiconductor (NASDAQ: LSCC) also rose 13% after revenue climbed 118%. Advanced Energy (NASDAQ: AEIS) gained 10% after earnings of $3.65 beat estimates of $3.04. Eaton (NYSE: ETN), a large supplier of electrical infrastructure for data centers, raised its full-year EPS targets and is up 7%. Bleeker's takeaway: earnings are beating expectations and point to 2027 being bigger than Wall Street expects, so watch the picks and shovels plays as earnings season continues.

LITE.headline: AI Stocks Surge on Tuesday: AEHR, Fabrinet, and Lattice Semiconductor All Jump More than 10%
LITE.summary: Eric Bleeker of 24/7 Wall St. says the AI trade is showing life on Tuesday morning as a string of suppliers report strong results. The backdrop is rough: stocks in the technology, media and telecom momentum factor are down 62% from their 52-week high, a sharper correction than the dot-com bust, as hedge funds cut AI positions and money rotates into defensive areas like consumer staples. Shares of Aehr Test Systems (NASDAQ: AEHR) are up 22%. The company makes burn-in test equipment, and sales are expected to triple this year. Fabrinet (NYSE: FN) is up 13%, with CEO Seamus Grade saying optics demand looks very sustainable. That matters after Marvell Technology (NASDAQ: MRVL) announced a $115 billion buyout of Lumentum (NASDAQ: LITE), a deal that sent both stocks lower. Lattice Semiconductor (NASDAQ: LSCC) also rose 13% after revenue climbed 118%. Advanced Energy (NASDAQ: AEIS) gained 10% after earnings of $3.65 beat estimates of $3.04. Eaton (NYSE: ETN), a large supplier of electrical infrastructure for data centers, raised its full-year EPS targets and is up 7%. Bleeker's takeaway: earnings are beating expectations and point to 2027 being bigger than Wall Street expects, so watch the picks and shovels plays as earnings season continues.

In this video, Eric Bleeker, CFA, Chief Investment Officer of 24/7 Wall St., breaks down the biggest earnings movers and what their results reveal about the stock market. Apple (Nasdaq: AAPL) beat revenue and earnings expectations as iPhone sales surged 17.5%, but disappointing gross margins raised concerns. Palantir (Nasdaq: PLTR) delivered explosive 96% revenue growth, yet investors are questioning slower growth in U.S. commercial contract value. Shopify (NYSE: SHOP) plunged 16% after missing revenue expectations and disappointing on free cash flow, despite beating earnings estimates. Elsewhere, Revvity (NYSE: RVTY) rallied 9% after raising guidance, while Fiserv (Nasdaq: FISV) jumped 10% on stronger earnings and expanded cost-cutting plans. Meanwhile, Zebra Technologies (Nasdaq: ZBRA) tumbled 16% despite beating estimates and raising its outlook, and Dynatrace (NYSE: DT) cut earnings guidance due to margin pressures. The big takeaway? Investors are increasingly focused on profitability, margins, and forward guidance rather than headline earnings beats alone.
